Act6-1#1.t: Why haven't I seen my son lately?

Act6-1#2.zh: 这...听富安说少爷最近得了重病...
Act6-1#2.t: Well... Fu An says the young master has been gravely ill...

Act6-1#3.zh: 什么？！发生了这么大的事，怎从未曾听人提起？去把富安给我叫来问话！
Act6-1#3.t: What?! Something this serious and no one told me? Bring Fu An here to answer for it!

Act6-1#4.zh: 富安！少爷生了什么病？怎地不曾回报？！
Act6-1#4.t: Fu An! What illness does my son have? Why wasn't I told?!

Act6-1#5.zh: 不瞒老爷您说，少爷不害别的病，却害林冲的老婆。
Act6-1#5.t: To tell the truth, my lord, the young master suffers from no other illness than Lin Chong's wife.

Act6-1#6.zh: 林冲的老婆几时见他的？
Act6-1#6.t: When did he see Lin Chong's wife?

Act6-1#7.zh: 便是前月二十八日，在岳庙里见来；今经一月有余...
Act6-1#7.t: On the twenty-eighth of last month, at the Yue Temple. It's been over a month now...

Act6-1#8.zh: 当下富安将事件的来龙去脉加油添醋地说了一遍。
Act6-1#8.t: Fu An then told the whole story, with plenty of embellishment.

Act6-1#9.zh: 若要少爷病好，只除害了林冲的性命，教少爷得偿宿愿，这病便好得；若不如此，一定送了少爷性命。
Act6-1#9.t: If the young master is to recover, the only way is to do away with Lin Chong and let him have his heart's desire. Then he'll get well; otherwise it will surely cost him his life.

Act6-1#10.zh: 唔...若为惜林冲一人，便须送了我孩儿性命，这可不成；但这林冲不但武艺高强，又未曾犯过错，怎地害他？
Act6-1#10.t: Hmm... I can't let my boy die just to spare one Lin Chong. But this Lin Chong is a great fighter and has never done anything wrong. How can we bring him down?

Act6-1#11.zh: 小人有一计，只除....如此如此使得。
Act6-1#11.t: I have a plan, my lord. We simply... do it like this.

Act6-1#12.t: Good! Go and see to it!

Act6-1#13.zh: 高俅设计害林冲，林冲危在旦夕！
Act6-1#13.t: Gao Qiu plots against Lin Chong. Lin Chong is in mortal danger!
